environment.timing_note: Single native runs alongside other tasks, not controlled paired timings. No speedup claim; no browser Wasm runtime measurement.

protocol.mechanical: Anonymous pixel-only matching and optional foreground masks. Gauge-aligned adjacency allows one global chain reversal; rejected pages count as zero. Individual rotation, raster alignment, complete workflow not scored.

baseline.error: Scan silhouette is not a near-uniform strip

notes: First six new pages were tested after initial policy was fixed, then the calibrated-gap guard was derived to preserve the D2/D001 development solution. D3/D002 retested. Last three were used only after final policy was fixed.
Development and first six final results combine unchanged initial-policy executions with two rerun pages affected by the guard. All other cases have identical candidate-selection behavior.
D3/D012 is routed to color because its dark fraction is below the text-like threshold. Sparse or blank documents and mixed layouts remain difficult.
No raw scans, masks, or original images are redistributed.
